title: Miniforge3: setuptools is a package that allows users to download, build, install, upgrade, and uninstall Python…
description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the miniforge3 package affecting setuptools, a Python package management tool. The flaw impacts versions prior to 25.11.0.1-r6 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.1. The vulnerability allows local attackers with low complexity to potentially cause high confidentiality impact with limited integrity impact, without affecting availability. A patch is available in version 25.11.0.1-r6.
